usageNotes: Resumes a suspended (paused) QEMU VM on the specified node; the VM must already be in a paused state — calling this on a running or stopped VM has no effect. Requires VM.PowerMgmt on the VM's ACL path and returns a task UPID string representing the async resume job. The node must be online and the VM must reside on that node; resuming a VM that holds a cluster-level lock will fail unless skiplock is set (root only).

examples.summary: Resume a paused VM (VMID 105) on node pve1

tips: The returned UPID can be polled via GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to confirm the VM has fully resumed.
If the VM was suspended to disk (hibernate) rather than paused in memory, use the start endpoint instead — this endpoint only handles in-memory (SIGCONT) pauses.
nocheck bypasses some internal state validation and is intended for recovery scenarios; prefer omitting it under normal operations.
skiplock is a root-only escape hatch; use it only when a stuck lock is preventing a legitimate resume after confirming no conflicting operation is actually running.
